purpose: State the content of information heard from a source.
keywords: Plain clause + と聞いた / と聞きました.
I heard from Ms. Tanaka that the meeting was canceled.
I heard that shop is inexpensive.
I heard you are moving next month.
formation: Plain clause + と聞いた / と聞きました.
restrictions: The speaker reports having heard the information.
mistake: Use plain だ in a quoted noun predicate when needed.
